channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Championship: Middlesbrough oo kaalinta 1aad dib ugu laabatay, West Ham oo Portsmouth looga adkaaday
item.description: Middlesbrough ayaa Talaadadii 2-1 ku garaacday Swansea, kuna laabatay hoggaanka horyaalka Championship ee England, halka West Ham ay 1-0 ku lumisay Portsmouth.

item.title: Porto oo 1-0 ku garaacday Feyenoord, Oskar Pietuszewski oo gool degdeg ah dhaliyay
item.description: FC Porto ayaa Talaadadii garoonka De Kuip ee Rotterdam 1-0 kaga adkaatay Feyenoord wareegga 5aad ee Champions League, iyadoo goolka kaliya la dhaliyay labada daqiiqo ee ugu horreeya.

item.title: Denver Broncos oo hal kulan ganaax ku rideen J.K. Dobbins kahor kulanka Steelers
item.description: Kooxda NFL ee Denver Broncos ayaa hal kulan ganaax ku rideen orodyahanka J.K. Dobbins, sababo la xiriira dhaqan waxyeello u geystay kooxda, sida uu ku dhawaaqay tababaraha Sean Payton.

item.title: Real Betis oo 2-0 ku garaacday Slovan Bratislava, Cucho Hernández oo laba gool dhaliyay
item.description: Real Betis ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Bratislava 2-0 kaga adkaatay Slovan Bratislava wareegga 5aad ee Champions League, iyadoo labada goolba uu madax ku dhaliyay Cucho Hernández.

item.title: Manchester City iyo Napoli oo 2-2 kala qaatay, De Bruyne oo ku laabtay Etihad
item.description: Manchester City ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Etihad 2-2 la gashay Napoli wareegga 5aad ee Champions League, kadib markii Rayan Cherki uu gool barbareeye ah dhaliyay daqiiqado kahor dhammaadka.

item.title: Arsenal iyo Borussia Dortmund oo 1-1 kala qaatay, Arsenal oo mar kale hogaan lumisay
item.description: Arsenal ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Emirates 1-1 la gashay Borussia Dortmund wareegga 5aad ee Champions League, iyadoo markii labaad afar maalmood gudahood ay lumisay hogaan ay qeybtii hore haysatay.

item.title: Real Madrid oo 5-1 ku burburisay PSV, Bellingham oo dhaliyay gool cajiib ah
item.description: Real Madrid ayaa Talaadadii garoonka Santiago Bernabéu 5-1 kaga adkaatay PSV Eindhoven wareegga 5aad ee wajiga horyaalka Champions League, iyadoo qeybtii hore laga hogaaminayay.

item.title: Como oo 1-0 ku garaacday AEK Athens, Milla oo dhaliyay gool qurux badan
item.description: Kooxda Talyaaniga ee Como, oo uu tababaro Cesc Fàbregas, ayaa Talaadadii garoonkeeda Sinigaglia 1-0 kaga adkaatay AEK Athens wareegga 5aad ee Champions League.

item.title: RB Leipzig oo 3-1 ku garaacday Lens, Antonio Nusa oo laba gool dhaliyay
item.description: RB Leipzig ayaa Talaadadii 3-1 kaga adkaatay kooxda Faransiiska ee Lens wareegga 5aad ee Champions League, iyadoo Antonio Nusa uu laba gool dhaliyay.

item.title: Madaxweynaha Colombia oo qaraxii Villavicencio ku eedeeyay kooxda ka go'day FARC
item.description: Madaxweynaha Colombia, Abelardo de la Espriella, ayaa Talaadadii ku eedeeyay taliye ka tirsan kooxda EMC ee ka go'day FARC inuu abaabulay qarax baabuur oo xafiiska guddoomiyaha gobolka Meta lagu beegsaday, kaasoo ay ku dhaawacmeen ugu yaraan 23 qof.

item.title: Brandon Aiyuk oo noqday ciyaaryahan xor ah, wuxuuna booqasho ku tagayaa Washington Commanders
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka NFL ee Brandon Aiyuk, oo San Francisco 49ers ay sii daayeen, ayaa noqday ciyaaryahan xor ah kadib markii aysan jirin koox codsatay, wuxuuna Arbacada booqanayaa Washington Commanders.

item.title: Huawei oo lagu helay xatooyada sirta ganacsiga Mareykanka, balse laga sii daayay eedda ugu culus
item.description: Guddi garsoorayaal ah oo New York fadhiyay ayaa Talaadadii shirkadda tiknoolajiyadda Shiinaha ee Huawei ku helay shirqool lagu xadayo sirta ganacsiga iyo khiyaano bangi, balse waxay ka sii daayeen eedda ugu culus ee shirqoolka abaabulka dambiyada (racketeering).

item.title: Rag hubeysan oo dukaan weyn oo ku yaal Cartagena ee Colombia ku haysta ilaa 25 qof oo la afduubay
item.description: Rag hubeysan oo wajiyada qariyay ayaa Talaadadii la wareegay dukaan weyn oo ku yaal magaalada Cartagena ee dalka Colombia, kadib markii ay ku guuldareysteen isku day ay ku dhacayeen baabuur gaashaaman oo lacag qaada, sida ay sheegeen booliska iyo madaxweynaha dalka.

item.title: Davis Cup: Czechia oo 2-0 ku garaacday Canada, noqotayna kooxdii ugu horreysay ee gaarta semi-finalka
item.description: Xulka tennis-ka Czechia ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Bologna ee Talyaaniga 2-0 kaga adkaaday Canada wareegga rubuc-finalka ee Davis Cup, isagoo noqday kooxdii ugu horreysay ee u gudubta semi-finalka.

item.title: Ciidamada Iran oo sheegay inay soo rideen laba diyaaradood oo drone ah oo Mareykan ah oo ku sugnaa hawada Khaliijka
item.description: Ciidamada Iran ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in nidaamkooda difaaca cirka uu burburiyay laba diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn oo Mareykan ah, oo kala ah nooca Lucas iyo MQ-9, kuna sugnaa hawada gobolka Khaliijka. Mas'uuliyiinta Mareykanka weli kama aysan jawaabin sheegashadan.

item.title: Australia oo heshiis ka gaartay sharci ammaanka internetka oo shirkadaha tiknoolajiyada ku ganaaxaya bilyan
item.description: Dowladda Australia ayaa Talaadadii heshiis siyaasadeed ka gaartay soo bandhigidda sharci ammaanka internetka, kaas oo shirkadaha waaweyn ee tiknoolajiyada ku soo rogi kara ganaax gaaraya bilyan doollar haddii ay ku guuldareystaan ka hortagga waxyeellada la saadaalin karo ee internetka.

item.title: Tottenham oo heshiis cusub la saxiixatay Luca Williams-Barnett, da'yarka gool ku dhaliyay kulankiisii ugu horreeyay
item.description: Kooxda Tottenham Hotspur ayaa Talaadadii ku dhawaaqday in ciyaaryahanka 18 jirka ah Luca Williams-Barnett uu saxiixay heshiis cusub, maalmo kadib markii uu gool iyo baas gool keenay ku sameeyay kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee uu Premier League ka bilaabo.

item.title: Galatasaray oo 1-0 ku garaacday Aston Villa, Deniz Gül oo dhaliyay goolka kaliya
item.description: Galatasaray ayaa Talaadadii magaalada Istanbul 1-0 kaga adkaatay Aston Villa wareegga 5aad ee Champions League, iyadoo goolka kaliya uu daqiiqaddii 77aad dhaliyay Deniz Gül.

item.title: Bayern oo la kulantay wakiillada Musiala, Eberl: caafimaadkiisa ayaa ahaa mowduuca kowaad ee aan mushaharka ahayn
item.description: Agaasimaha ciyaaraha ee Bayern Munich Max Eberl ayaa sheegay in kulan Talaadadii ay la yeesheen wakiillada Jamal Musiala uu ahaa mid wax ku ool ah, isla markaana diiradda la saaray soo kabashada ciyaaryahanka ee ma ahayn heshiiskiisa.

item.title: PGA Tour oo shaacisay musharixiinta abaalmarinta ciyaaryahanka sannadka, Scottie Scheffler oo ku jira
item.description: Ururka golf-ka ee PGA Tour ayaa Talaadadii magacaabay shanta ciyaaryahan ee u tartamaya abaalmarinta Jack Nicklaus ee ciyaaryahanka sannadka, iyadoo Scottie Scheffler, Cameron Young iyo Wyndham Clark ay hormuud u yihiin.

item.title: Bodø/Glimt oo 1-0 ku garaacday LASK, gool la dhaliyay daqiiqaddii 92aad
item.description: Kooxda Norway ee Bodø/Glimt ayaa Talaadadii garoonkeeda Aspmyra 1-0 kaga adkaatay LASK ee Austria wareegga 5aad ee Champions League, iyadoo goolka uu dhaliyay Helmersen daqiiqaddii 92aad.

item.title: Toronto Blue Jays oo la sheegay inay qandaraas 80 milyan oo doollar ah la galeen tuuraha reer Japan Kaima Taira
item.description: Kooxda baseball-ka ee Toronto Blue Jays ayaa la sheegay inay heshiis shan sano ah oo qiimihiisu yahay 80 milyan oo doollar la gashay tuuraha kubadda ee reer Japan Kaima Taira, sida ay warbixinno kala duwan sheegeen.

item.title: Golaha Wasiirrada oo ansixiyey wax-ka-beddelka xeerarka doorashooyinka iyo xisbiyada siyaasadda
item.description: Golaha Wasiirrada Xukuumadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ayaa ansixiyey hindise-sharciyeedyo wax-ka-beddel ku sameynaya 23 qodob oo Xeerka Doorashooyinka Qaranka ah iyo 8 qodob oo Xeerka Ururrada iyo Xisbiyada Siyaasadda ah, oo ay ku jiraan 10% xisbi qaran iyo liiska xiran ee musharraxiinta.

item.title: Putin oo sheegay in aargoosi uu yahay lama-huraan kadib weerarrada Ukraine ee warshadaha shidaalka Ruushka
item.description: Madaxweynaha Ruushka Vladimir Putin ayaa Talaadadii sheegay in Ukraine ay sii wadday weerarrada ay ku qaadayso warshadaha sifeynta shidaalka ee Ruushka, in kasta oo Madaxweynaha Mareykanka Donald Trump uu ka codsaday inay joojiso, wuxuuna ku hanjabay aargoosi.

item.title: Florian Wirtz oo ammaanay Iraola iyo Klopp, kuna dhawaaqay inuu ku jiro heerkiisii ugu fiicnaa Liverpool
item.description: Xiddigga Liverpool Florian Wirtz ayaa Talaadadii shir jaraa'id oo uu ku qabtay Belgium ku sheegay in tababaraha Andoni Iraola uu ka caawiyay inuu dib u helo qaabkiisii, kahor kulanka Champions League ee kooxdiisa iyo Club Brugge.

item.title: Guingamp oo joojisay kulankii ay la yeelan lahayd Cyril Hanouna kadib cabashada taageerayaasha
item.description: Kooxda Ligue 2 ee En Avant Guingamp ayaa Talaadadii ku dhawaaqday in aysan la kulmi doonin bandhig-qabiyaha telefishanka Faransiiska Cyril Hanouna, oo loo malaynayay inuu maalgashi ku sameyn karo kooxda, kadib markii taageerayaashu ay ka cabteen.

item.title: Khilaaf culus oo ka dhex taagan Wasiirka Duulista iyo Maareeyaha Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka Soomaaliya
item.description: Khilaaf maamul oo u dhexeeya Wasiirka Gaadiidka iyo Duulista Hawada Soomaaliya iyo Maareeyaha Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka, Axmed Macallin, ayaa dhaliyey su'aalo la xiriira awood-qaybsiga, madax-bannaanida hay'adaha dowladda iyo cidda leh mas'uuliyadda ugu dambeysa ee kormeerka duulista rayidka dalka.

item.title: Jannik Sinner oo qalliin yar lagu sameeyay jilibka midig, toddobaadyo kahor Australian Open
item.description: Jannik Sinner, oo ah ciyaaryahanka labaad ee tennis-ka adduunka, ayaa 24 November shaaciyay in lagu sameeyay qalliin yar oo jilibkiisa midig ah, toddoba toddobaad kahor bilowga Australian Open ee Janaayo.

item.title: Helikobtar milatari oo ka tirsan Ciidamada Cirka Turkiga oo ku burburtay Eskisehir
item.description: Wasaaradda Difaaca Turkiga ayaa sheegtay in 24 November helikobtar nooca Cougar ah oo ka tirsan Ciidamada Cirka uu burburay kadib markii uu ka kacay magaalada Eskisehir si uu u galo duulimaad tababar.

item.title: Luka Modric oo dhaawac muruq ah dartiis u seegaya kulanka Milan ee Olympiacos
item.description: Kooxda AC Milan ayaa la sheegay in Luka Modric uu seegi doono kulanka Khamiista ee Europa League ee Olympiacos, kadib dhaawac muruqa bowdada midig ah oo uu ka soo gaaray kulankii Frosinone.
